solution: $\\sin3\\theta=\\sin(2\\theta+\\theta)=\\sin2\\theta\\cos\\theta+\\cos2\\theta\\sin\\theta=2\\sin\\theta\\cos^{2}\\theta+(1-2\\sin^{2}\\theta)\\sin\\theta=2\\sin\\theta(1-\\sin^{2}\\theta)+\\sin\\theta-2\\sin^{3}\\theta=3\\sin\\theta-4\\sin^{3}\\theta$. With $\\theta=18^{\\circ}$: $\\sin54^{\\circ}=\\cos36^{\\circ}=1-2\\sin^{2}18^{\\circ}$. So $1-2s^{2}=3s-4s^{3}$, i.e. $4s^{3}-2s^{2}-3s+1=0$ where $s=\\sin18^{\\circ}$. Factoring $(s-1)(4s^{2}+2s-1)=0$; the positive root of the quadratic is $\\tfrac{-1+\\sqrt5}{4}$. Hence $\\sin18^{\\circ}=\\tfrac{\\sqrt5-1}{4}$.
